secrets.name: SETTINGS_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Django SECRET_KEY for session/token signing. Required at boot.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
secrets.description: Cloudinary cloud name for image storage (service listings, profile photos). Get from Cloudinary dashboard.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Cloudinary API key. Get from Cloudinary dashboard.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET
secrets.description: Cloudinary API secret. Get from Cloudinary dashboard.

secrets.name: RAZORPAY_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Razorpay key ID for payment processing. Get from Razorpay dashboard.

secrets.name: RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET
secrets.description: Razorpay key secret for payment processing. Get from Razorpay dashboard.

secrets.name: EMAIL_HOST_USER
secrets.description: Gmail address for sending transactional emails. Get from your email provider.

secrets.name: EMAIL_HOST_PASSWORD
secrets.description: App password for the email account. Get from your email provider.

secrets.name: DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL
secrets.description: From address for outgoing emails. Get from your email provider.
